svg.title: Green Curve I
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Painted white upper-left area retained inside the parallelogram. Only surrounding wall is transparent; curved boundary is approximate.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://buffaloakg.org/artworks/2023222-green-curve-i; source object 2023:222; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
